targets.queryText: SELECT CAST((distance_km/(duration_min/60.0))/10 AS INT)*10 || '' as fascia, ROUND(AVG(efficiency_kwh_100km),1) as "kWh/100km" FROM trips WHERE duration_min > 2 AND distance_km > 0.5 AND efficiency_kwh_100km IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%s', started_at)*1000 >= $__from AND strftime('%s', started_at)*1000 <= $__to GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CAST((distance_km/(duration_min/60.0))/10 AS INT)
